fieldNotes.facilityStatus: General Mills closed this Lodi Cheerios plant in 2015; the 1.1M sq ft complex on 66+ acres is now a multi-tenant industrial property (Bond Manufacturing and others). Audited as the physical freight site at the roster address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully enclosed by continuous chain-link fence; the truck driveways off W Turner Rd are gated openings (rolling chain-link gates). Medium confidence - gates not clearly closed in 2025 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard-booth structure visible at any entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gated driveways but no staffed booth; multi-tenant repurposed site implies tenant/self check-in.
fieldNotes.railServed: UP Rail spur runs into the property; a railroad-crossing sign is on W Turner Rd at the dock face. Listings confirm UP Rail service.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large numbered trailer drop yard on the west side; property listing cites 196 trailer drops.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the long north face (along W Turner Rd) and a separate rail-served dock cluster on the east face.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus of multiple connected/adjacent industrial buildings, now multi-tenant.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits at the edge of Lodi (small city) ringed by single-family residential - small-town industrial, classed Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance aprons and a vast paved yard provide ample room for express lanes.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~45 estimated (north face ~30+ doors visible in Street View, plus east rail dock); honest band estimate.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least two driveway entrances off W Turner Rd serve the yard.

citations.claim: GM announced it would shut and sell the Lodi cereal plant in a NA supply-chain consolidation
Cereal production ended Nov 2015; RRM Enterprises (Bond Manufacturing) bought the property, sale closed Feb 29 2016

verification.rationale: GM closed the Lodi Cheerios plant (Nov 2015) and sold it Feb 2016; now a multi-tenant industrial property (Bond Manufacturing et al). Not GM-operated.
